sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Freecell Solitaire Deluxe are straightforward and easy to learn. Players are presented with a standard deck of 52 cards, shuffled and dealt into eight columns on the game board. The objective of the game is to move all the cards to the four foundation piles, which are located in the upper right corner of the game board. The foundation piles are built up in suit from Ace to King, and players can only move cards to the foundation piles when they are in the correct sequence.

To move cards around the game board, players use the mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to drag and drop cards into place. Cards can be moved to the foundation piles, the free cells, or other columns on the game board. Players can also use the draw pile to add new cards to the game board, or the stock pile to add a new card to the game board.

As players progress through the game, they will encounter obstacles such as locked cards and blocked columns. To overcome these obstacles, players must use their strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to move cards around the game board and clear the way for the cards they need to move. With practice and patience, players can master the core gameplay mechanics of Freecell Solitaire Deluxe and become a solitaire champion.

Freecell Solitaire Deluxe also features a unique feature called the free cells. These four empty cells located above the game board can be used to move cards around the game board and free up space for new cards. Players can use the free cells to move cards to the foundation piles, or to move cards from the foundation piles to the free cells. This feature adds a new level of strategy and complexity to the game, making it even more challenging and fun to play.
